summary: New Agent and agent definition installs deliver the Emberpath client key an Emberpath alias model needs (emberpath_client_key, checked against Emberpath's model list, sent only to an explicit MAGNUS_ARDENT_EMBERPATH_URL, never stored), and POST /ardent/installations/:nodeId/profiles/:name/model-credential sets or rotates it on an existing agent. Both need node agents at studio level 6 (upgrade agents first) and a HiveXUI release after 0.14.0 for the key field. Wazuh 5 manager endpoint reporting. Ardent stays 3.5.1. One fast migration widens the Ardent operation kind check to model-credential.
